questions.text: What are the reasons for the South West monsoons to recede in October?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the reasons for the South West monsoons to recede in October? (Difficult)

answer.value:
Because of the Wide-spread South-West Monsoon rains,
There is a decrease in the temperature.
During this season, the sun rays fall Vertically on the Southern hemisphere.
As a result, there is a drop in the temperature in the Northern hemisphere.
Hence this area becomes an area of high pressure.
The South-West monsoon winds start receeding.

questions.text: “Indian agriculture is a gambling with the monsoons” Justify.
questions.text_as_printed: “Indian agriculture is a gambling with the monsoons” Justify. (April-2015, 2017, 2018, June-2017) (Average)

answer.value:
Agriculture is the main occupation.
Climatic has a great influence on the economy.
The South-West monsoons control the agriculture of India.
Failure of rainfall leads to drought.
Heavy rainfall leads floods.
They cause destruction to life and property.
Hence it is said that Indian agriculture is a “Gamble with the monsoons”.
